haiku.problem: This asks about Manasseh's failure at one group of towns, a minor detail. The main narrative event, the house of Joseph's attack on Bethel and the spies' deal with the man from the city, has no question in the set, even though its cards (1-6, 1-8, 1-9, 1-11) were available.
"Him" comes before the question names God, so the baker can't tell who it refers to. It should name God, for example "Because Israel did not obey God".
